name: Card Feature Test
author: Test card
description: Pick a tab. Each one tests a different card type.

steps.title: Install
steps.text:
Press Install Add-ons.
Pick Its Games when it asks.

steps.title: Set ReShade
steps.text:
On the ReShade card, pick the Add-on build.
Turn on Inject Mode (the syringe button).

steps.title: Play
steps.text:
Press Play next to DOOM.
The FPS Limiter is in ReShade's Add-ons tab.

steps.title: Start it
steps.text: Press Launch Magpie. It sits in the tray.

steps.title: Scale a game
steps.text:
Run a game in a window.
Press Alt+Shift+A to make it fill the screen.

steps.title: Read me first
steps.text:
This tab has no games and no button.
It only shows guides.

steps.title: Open the next guide
steps.text: Guides start closed and can't hold other guides.

steps.title: Still stuck
steps.text: Remove the card and load it again.

options.label: Add-on
options.heading: Add-on Card
options.author: RenoDX team
options.description:
An add-on card: the RenoDX FPS Limiter (by the RenoDX team).
1. Its game: DOOM Eternal, with Vulkan locked by the card.
2. Tick Extras to also get Daodan's shaders.
3. Open the Setup Guide below.

options.label: Shaders
options.heading: Shader Card
options.author: prod80
options.description:
A shader card: prod80's color shaders, through Shader Repositories.
1. Its games: Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher 3.
2. The Look list is only on this tab.

options.label: Program
options.heading: Program Card
options.author: Blinue
options.description:
A program card: Magpie, an upscaler for games in a window.
1. Download, then Launch Magpie.
2. Its game: Hollow Knight, with Proxy suggested (amber edge).

options.label: Organizer
options.heading: Organizer Card
options.description:
An organizer card: no install button, just your games.
1. Its games: Starfield and Elden Ring.
2. The style choice is only on this tab.

options.label: Guides
options.heading: Guide Card
options.description: A guide card: two guides, no games and no button.
